title: Kenning — Hover Dictionary for English Learners
description: Hover an English word to see its pronunciation and its meaning in Chinese and English. Offline: the dictionary ships inside the extension.

title: Plan Pilot
description: Turn long AI-generated plans into a step-by-step visual view. Discuss each step with Claude Code or Copilot, and execute it one step at a time.

title: AgentGuards — Extension Scanner
description: Checks the extensions you install for malware and vulnerable bundled code, on the AgentGuards service. Warns you and offers one-click uninstall.

title: Сфера
description: Язык программирования «Сфера»: подсветка синтаксиса, ошибки в реальном времени, подсказки и автодополнение.

title: Antitheft
description: Stop infostealers in extensions, AI agents and the programs they start from stealing your wallets and passwords, and see who opens your secrets. Works with the Antitheft app.
